title: Normalized quotient sections and fraction-chart comparison predicates
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], $A=\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)$ its canonical symmetric graded algebra [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], and $p:P\to S$ its relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Fix a normalized tautological quotient $D=(Q,q_P)$ [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Use the section-normalized composite pullback comparison [def-pc-module-pullback]. For $h:T\to S$, $u:T'\to T$ and $q:h^*\mathcal E\to L$, define $\operatorname{lineQuotientPullback}(q)$ as the comparison followed by $u^*q$. For a section $m$ over an affine base $U$, define the tautological section as its adjoint image under $q_P$, and its section along $F:T\to P$ by tensor pullback and restriction. For a frame $l$ on an affine $W$, write $b_m$ for the unique scalar coefficient of $q(m)$ [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map]. Define $\mathrm{InverseLineChartNormalization}$ to require $\theta(e_m)=b_m l$ on every smaller open, freeness of $e_m$ when $b_m$ is a unit, the quotient ratio formula for every section $v$, and $e_m=(b_m/b_n)e_n$ when $b_n$ is a unit. Define $\mathrm{RecoveredQuotientFrame}$ as coefficient one for the pulled tautological frame. Define $\mathrm{RecoveredFractionCoefficients}$ as $b(c)=a^*(c/e_m^d)$ for every homogeneous $c$ of degree $d$ and every affine factorization through the $e_m$ chart. Define $\mathrm{QuotientFractionNaturality}$ as equality of homogeneous and generator coefficients after arbitrary pullback, together with a scalar-preserving homomorphism of away localizations carrying each fraction to the fraction of its images. These are predicates, with no asserted existence of $\theta$ or the fraction comparisons.

source.place: Tags 01OA (section-projective-bundle) and 01O4 (lemma-apply-relative); inverse quotient constructions and their arbitrary-pullback compatibility, with the explicit degree-one chart calculations.

proof.text: The normalized section and composition pullback constructions of [def-pc-module-pullback] define the pulled quotient. Apply adjunction to the quotient datum [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data] to define tautological sections, then pull them back and restrict. The remaining predicates are the displayed equations in frames and fraction charts of [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map], with all affine opens and refinements quantified. No existence theorem is invoked to define data.
